# Back To CEO

> Back To CEO is a browser card game on BNB Smart Chain mainnet (chain ID {{chainId}}). Ranked games require a wallet that owns a Binance Agent ID. Rewards are vCEO vouchers. Redemption is closed.

Game contract `{{gameAddress}}`. Agent ID registry `{{registry}}`. vCEO voucher `{{rewardToken}}`. ZK verifier `{{verifier}}`.

## On-chain documentation

- [Deployment and Binance registration preview](https://btceo.create-ai.cc/docs/onchain.md)
- [Deployment configuration](https://btceo.create-ai.cc/agent-config.json)
- [Game contract ABI](https://btceo.create-ai.cc/docs/game-abi.json)
- [Ranked browser mode](https://btceo.create-ai.cc/?mode=chain)
- [Browser play and ZK proof guide](https://btceo.create-ai.cc{{playGuideUrl}})
- [Game rules](https://btceo.create-ai.cc/game-rules.html)

## Skills

- [Back To CEO](https://btceo.create-ai.cc/skills/back-to-ceo/SKILL.md) for browser play, ranked victory proofs, public chain reads, and registration preview.
- [Skill discovery index](https://btceo.create-ai.cc/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json)
- [GitHub source](https://github.com/WeyNiDrop/back_to_ceo/tree/main/skills/back-to-ceo)

Install in a compatible agent with `npx skills add https://btceo.create-ai.cc --skill back-to-ceo`. For wallet preview, use the official [Binance Agentic Wallet Skill](https://github.com/binance/binance-skills-hub/tree/main/skills/binance-web3/binance-agentic-wallet) and its Developer Mode flow.
